# .github/workflows/jpx-analysis.yml
# JPX Market Analysis - Automated Pipeline
#
# Triggers:
#   1. Push Excel/CSV files to data/  (busy days: just drop the raw files)
#   2. Manual dispatch (optional Nikkei/VI override)
#
# Flow: unpack state.json -> parse raw data -> (manual ⑧ if present, else
#       deterministic 定型⑧) -> render index.html -> pack state.json ->
#       tidy data/ -> commit & deploy (GitHub Pages serves index.html).
#
# No GEMINI_API_KEY needed: the ⑧ is either your manual_assessment_<date>.md
# or a deterministic template built from the real numbers.

name: JPX Daily Analysis

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'data/*.xlsx'
      - 'data/*.xls'
      - 'data/*.csv'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      nikkei:
        description: 'Nikkei 225 close (leave empty for auto-fetch)'
        required: false
        type: string
      vi:
        description: 'Nikkei VI close (leave empty for auto-fetch)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install openpyxl xlrd

      - name: List data files
        run: |
          echo "=== Files in data/ ==="
          ls -la data/ || echo "No data/ directory"

      - name: Run pipeline
        run: |
          ARGS="--datadir data --outdir ."
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.nikkei }}" ]; then
            ARGS="$ARGS --nikkei ${{ github.event.inputs.nikkei }}"
          fi
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.vi }}" ]; then
            ARGS="$ARGS --vi ${{ github.event.inputs.vi }}"
          fi
          python scripts/run_pipeline.py $ARGS

      - name: Cleanup old raw files in data/ (keep latest of each type)
        run: |
          cd data
          for pattern in "open_interest" "derivatives_market_data" "volume_by_participant" "tp.csv" "indexfut_oi_by_tp" "nk225op_oi_by_tp"; do
            files=$(ls -1 *${pattern}* 2>/dev/null | sort -r)
            count=0
            for f in $files; do
              count=$((count + 1))
              if [ $count -gt 1 ]; then
                echo "Removing old: $f"; rm -f "$f"
              else
                echo "Keeping latest: $f"
              fi
            done
          done

      - name: Tidy generated JSON in data/ (keep state.json only)
        run: |
          # removes scratch JSON (greeks/jnet/iv/weekly_trend/opt_weekly/positions/data),
          # drops the 4 history files now bundled inside state.json, archives old ⑧ md.
          python scripts/cleanup.py --dir data --apply --drop-unbundled --keep-md 7 || true

      - name: List generated files
        run: |
          echo "=== Generated ==="
          ls -la index.html data/state.json 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Commit and push
        run: |
          git config user.name "JPX Analysis Bot"
          git config user.email "bot@jpx-analysis.local"
          # deploy artifact + carry-over state + inputs/archive; -A also stages deletions
          git add index.html
          git add -A data/
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d)
            git commit -m "${DATE} analysis update [automated]"
            git push
          fi
